structured_output.what_is_happening: AR Dogy (DOGY) is a pump.fun bonding-curve coin, about 3.3h old. Its name refers to a TikTok AR effect called "AR Dogy", and one of its social links is a status post from an X account called commando100x. The coin rose about 580-690% over 6h to roughly $30k market cap. At detection it was already about 25% below its all-time-high price (4.0e-5 vs 3.0e-5), and momentum is turning over. In the last 5 minutes GeckoTerminal shows 1 buyer against 14 sellers and the price down 7-20%. The last 15 minutes are down 13%. Most of the h1 volume came in the m30 burst, and flow is now dropping off. GMGN tags 174 of 228 traders as bundlers, and the top bundler traders hold about 35% of supply. The dev's token status is "creator_close" (fully out), the dev has 11 prior launches, and the coin is flagged as a community takeover. The curve is at 91.9 of about 115 virtual SOL, so it is roughly 80% of the way to migration.

narrative.description: Meme built on a TikTok AR filter or effect, 'AR Dogy'. It is a platform-trend meme: when a TikTok effect goes viral, people launch coins named after it. The packet can't confirm how viral the effect actually is. There is no website or Telegram, and the only X link is a single status post that looks like a call or KOL post rather than a project account.
narrative.why_spreading: It probably spread because a TikTok effect was trending and at least one X caller posted about it. At least 10 other 'AR Dogy' or 'DOGY' coins were launched within hours of each other, which points to a small trend that many people tried to farm. Attention seems to have peaked in the last 30-60 minutes and is now cooling.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the only AR Dogy variant with real volume and a live curve. It has more than 1,000 unique buyers in 6h, a DexScreener profile and a CTO flag, while every copycat shows zero liquidity or near-zero h1 volume. It is the de facto winner among the same-name launches.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 10 same-name or same-ticker tokens exist. Two of them (ECd2…, GUuyg…) are older than this pair, at about 1790220xxx vs 1790245038. All are dead or illiquid.

authenticity.evidence: Some real participation: 1,013 unique buyers over 6h, 748 holders on RugCheck, the top 10 holders under 25% of supply excluding the curve, and top holders each around 2-3%. Against that: 174 of 228 GMGN-tagged traders are bundlers, the top bundler traders hold about 35%, the bot/degen rate is 54%, and there are 4 rat traders plus a 4-wallet transfer insider network. The dev sold out completely and has 11 serial launches. The promotion is a caller's X post rather than a real project.
authenticity.uncertainty: The GMGN bundler counts may be inflated by bot-routed buys. Without X data I can't gauge how big the TikTok trend or the caller's reach really is.

structural_risks: Bundler clusters holding about 35% can dump into a thin curve (about $21k equivalent depth)
Momentum is reversing: m5 shows 1 buyer vs 14 sellers, and the price is about 25% below its ATH at detection
Dev has already exited and is a serial launcher with 11 tokens, best ATH about $127k
Doubling to about $60k probably means completing the curve and migrating, and sellers often dump right at migration
The stop sits around $15k, and a round trip back toward curve start after a 6x run is common

structured_output.counterargument: The curve is already 80% complete, and a TikTok-effect meme can find a second wave as the effect spreads. Coins near migration often get a push from bots and buyers betting on the migration, and a KOL/CTO group seems to be backing it. A fresh round of buying from about $30k could carry it through migration toward $60-80k within 6 hours. Holder distribution among non-bundlers is fairly flat, and 9 smart wallets plus 1 renowned wallet are present.

structured_output.thesis: A post-peak, heavily bundled pump.fun meme copying a TikTok effect. The move is already about 6x from launch and momentum is fading, with sellers far outnumbering buyers in the last 5-15 minutes. Getting to 2x means pushing through migration against about 35% bundler supply and a dev who has already exited. The more likely path is a bleed toward the -50% stop, so this is a fade with a small chance of a migration squeeze.
